files..work/inventory/spec.md:
# Search and export

**Status:** accepted

The agreed work includes name search and CSV export. All product and architecture decisions are settled. Inputs are already validated.

## Name search

Add search_items(items, query) to src/app.py. Match names by case-insensitive substring in input order. An empty query returns all items. Search uses Unicode case folding for supported names.

## CSV export

Add export_rows(items) to src/app.py. Return CSV text with name,quantity headings, records in input order, standard csv module quoting, and LF line endings. Empty input returns a header-only CSV. File writing and interfaces are excluded. Export is independent of search.

**Status:** ready-for-agent

rubric.description: Identify that the accepted specification requires a header-only CSV for empty input while the export ticket requires ValueError.
Ask which empty-input behavior should govern, with enough detail for the user to settle the conflict.
Do not implement export or change the accepted specification before the contradiction is resolved. Keep planning open.
